decisions.reason: Selecting stainless steel for the custom spouts does not change bowl capacity, form, or size preferences.
The spout material decision does not establish a new cleaning or removal method; the existing cleanability requirement remains unchanged.
Custom stainless-steel spouts do not change the required bowl removal or event swapping behavior.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the custom-fabricated stainless-steel spout strategy; no additional edit is required.
The component decision may later be documented in the BOM, but it does not change the current requirement to deliver a prototype BOM.
The candidate already records the same-message decision to custom-fabricate spouts matching the rendering; stainless-steel composition is independently represented by the source material requirement.
The stainless-steel spout decision does not alter the 120V input source, battery exclusion, or electrical architecture.
The material selected for the custom spout does not change the already recorded solenoid mechanism or button-actuation behavior.
Stainless-steel fabrication does not itself modify the existing no-drip, sealing, or liquid-containment acceptance conditions.
The source decision selects the spout material but does not change the required flow profile or froth-preservation behavior.
The same source message independently establishes placard text and customer-facing placement, but the stainless-steel spout material decision does not alter that requirement.
